title: LLMs Learned to Talk. Jev Wants AI to *Decide*.
dek: A small experiment into what happens when we separate reasoning from decision-making.
takeaways: A lot of software needs a decision, not a paragraph: team, priority, escalate.
Jev answers predefined questions with a choice, a score or a yes/no probability. The developer sets the answer space.
Early results are promising but narrow. The real question is which decisions actually need an LLM.
